cases.name: Vague complaint does not trigger an edit
cases.scenario: A reviewer says the skill is too verbose but provides no input, output, or expected result.

actions: Request the exact input, actual output, and expected output.
Do not propose a permanent instruction change.
forbidden: Add a be concise rule.
Guess which section caused the verbosity.
completion_evidence: A rerunnable case with an observable pass/fail distinction.

cases.name: Intermittent failure remains an evidence problem
cases.scenario: The same calendar request succeeds twice and fails once with no captured connector state.

actions: Capture failure conditions and connector state.
Treat Capability Gap as a hypothesis, not a conclusion.
forbidden: Add retry instructions without evidence.
Classify the issue as Knowledge Gap.
completion_evidence: Conditions that distinguish a passing run from a failing run.

cases.name: Disconnected connector routes to dependency owner
cases.scenario: Calendar retrieval returns nothing because the connector is disconnected; the skill instructions are otherwise sufficient.

actions: Report the disconnected dependency.
Leave skill instructions unchanged unless silent failure is the reported defect.
forbidden: Add calendar retrieval rules.
Classify the issue as Knowledge Gap.
completion_evidence: The failed dependency and its owner are named.

cases.name: Silent dependency failure permits one graceful fallback
cases.scenario: A disconnected connector causes the skill to claim success instead of reporting that retrieval was unavailable.

actions: Add one narrow instruction to disclose connector unavailability and stop.
Route the connector outage to its owner.
forbidden: Add alternate calendar logic.
Broaden the skill's responsibility.
completion_evidence: Unavailable retrieval is surfaced instead of reported as success.

cases.name: Out-of-scope request narrows routing
cases.scenario: A commit-message skill is invoked to review a pull request and produces a weak review.

actions: Narrow the trigger or decline the request.
Route to the pull-request review owner.
forbidden: Add review instructions to the commit-message skill.
Classify weak review content as Knowledge Gap.
completion_evidence: The correct owner is named and the misrouting path is closed.

cases.name: Boundary classification takes precedence over content
cases.scenario: An out-of-scope request also exposes a factual omission in the invoked skill's output.

actions: Resolve the ownership error before considering content.
Do not diagnose instructions for a case the skill should not own.
forbidden: Patch the factual omission in the misrouted skill.
completion_evidence: The out-of-scope path no longer invokes the skill.

cases.name: Missing stable format is a Knowledge Gap
cases.scenario: A document skill uses arbitrary filenames because the required YYYYMMDD prefix is absent from its instructions.

actions: Add the exact filename convention.
Explain that the ingestion parser depends on the date prefix.
forbidden: Add a broad always use descriptive filenames rule.
completion_evidence: The required format and its operational reason are explicit.

cases.name: Misapplied depth is a Judgment Gap
cases.scenario: The skill knows all required facts but produces a two-page report for a one-line status request.

actions: Rewrite the existing depth instruction to calibrate detail to decision and audit weight.
forbidden: Add an always be brief rule.
Remove required depth for corrective-action analysis.
completion_evidence: The instruction states when short and detailed outputs are appropriate.

cases.name: Conflicting constraints are a Behavioral Regression
cases.scenario: A new under-ten-steps rule causes troubleshooting output to omit mandatory alarm context that previously appeared.

actions: Merge the length and alarm-context constraints into one ordered principle.
Preserve mandatory context before optimizing length.
forbidden: Add a third exception rule.
Delete the alarm-context invariant.
completion_evidence: Both required context and calibrated length coexist without conflict.

cases.name: Fast-changing model roster is externalized
cases.scenario: A model-selection skill repeatedly becomes stale because current model versions are hardcoded in SKILL.md.

actions: Resolve model availability at run time from the maintained catalog.
Remove hardcoded version strings.
forbidden: Replace old model versions with today's versions.
Add another reminder to keep the list current.
completion_evidence: The skill has one maintained runtime source for the changing roster.

cases.name: Stable schema remains an instance repair
cases.scenario: A fixed frontmatter schema omits one allowed field and has not changed in years.

actions: Add the missing stable field and its purpose.
forbidden: Build a runtime schema service.
Introduce configuration machinery for a stable value.
completion_evidence: The stable schema is complete without new infrastructure.

cases.name: Duplicate guidance is merged before adding rules
cases.scenario: Three sections repeat slightly different requirements for citing sources, and QA finds inconsistent citation placement.

actions: Create one authoritative citation policy.
Delete overlapping normative copies.
Keep only role-specific pointers if necessary.
forbidden: Add a fourth citation rule.
Leave contradictory copies in place.
completion_evidence: One authoritative policy remains and instruction count does not increase.

cases.name: Long cohesive skill is not split prematurely
cases.scenario: A long skill has one invocation, one owner, and one end-to-end completion criterion, but its branch-specific examples are bulky.

actions: Prune duplication.
Move branch-specific examples behind a contextual reference.
Keep the cohesive workflow together.
forbidden: Create a new top-level skill based only on line count.
completion_evidence: Core workflow remains cohesive and rare detail is progressively disclosed.

cases.name: Broken caller contract expands verification, not scope
cases.scenario: A trigger clarification changes wording consumed by one complementary routing skill; two unrelated skills also mention the domain.

actions: Rerun the target case.
Test the complementary router.
Update only the caller whose existing contract broke.
Document why unrelated skills need no change.
forbidden: Patch every skill mentioning the domain.
Skip adjacent-case validation.
completion_evidence: Target and affected caller pass; unaffected callers have a no-change rationale.

cases.name: Missing change-control owner uses disclosed fallback
cases.scenario: The user explicitly requests a skill edit, validation passes, but skill-change-control is unavailable.

actions: Disclose the unavailable change-control owner.
Use the validated create-skill save workflow because the user explicitly requested the edit.
forbidden: Pretend change control ran.
Silently abandon the requested edit.
completion_evidence: Capability gap is disclosed and the validated package is saved through the authorized fallback.

cases.name: Incomplete checkpoint blocks save
cases.scenario: The target case passes, but the checkpoint omits blast-radius results and preserved invariants.

actions: Block the save.
Complete caller checks and name preserved invariants.
forbidden: Treat package validation alone as sufficient.
Save with missing checkpoint fields.
completion_evidence: Every checkpoint field is complete and package validation passes.
